description: Defines an enum 'IntentFlag' representing various Android intent flags, including their relationships such as complements, conflicts, and requests.

classes.name: IntentFlag
classes.description: An enum representing different Android intent flags with associated relationships and utility methods.

methods.name: getComplements
methods.description: Returns a set of flags that complement this flag.

methods.name: getConflicts
methods.description: Returns a set of flags that conflict with this flag.

methods.name: getRequests
methods.description: Returns a set of flags that are necessary for this flag.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the intent flag.

methods.name: setOf
methods.description: Utility method to create a set of IntentFlag instances from varargs.
